cards.p: Someone wants a [size] [flavor] cake for [date]. Reply: my price [price], what changes it, order by [day].
Write the 8 questions to ask on every custom cake order. One short line each, ready for my form.
Confirm [name]'s order: [cake details], pickup [date and time], total [amount], deposit paid [amount]. Short text.
Someone wants a custom cake by tomorrow. Write a kind reply: I can do [option] or need [days] days.
Write a pickup day text for [name]: ready at [time], our address [address], how to carry the box.
[Name] wants to change the cake design [days] days before pickup. Reply with what I can still change.
An office wants [number] cookies on [date]. Reply with my box sizes [sizes], prices and lead time.
Text past customers: holiday preorders open [date], close [date], menu [items], order link [link].
Plan my bake day from these orders and pickup times [paste]. List what to bake, decorate and box, by hour.
Scale this recipe [paste] from [number] to [number] servings. Show each amount in grams and cups.
From this week's orders [paste] and my recipes [paste], list every ingredient and amount I need to buy.
Write my flavor menu from this list [paste]: one tasty line each, under 12 words, no big claims.
Reply to this review saying the cake looked different from the photo: [paste]. Kind, own it, offer [fix].
Reply to this 5 star review [paste] by name, mention the [cake], invite them back for [holiday].
Write a short text for the day after [name]'s party asking for a Google review, link [link]. No pressure.
A review is upset we sold out before noon: [paste]. Write a calm reply and how to preorder next time.
Write a short post for this morning's case: [items], open until [time], what sells out first.
Write a post on how we make [item] in 4 short steps. Warm, plain words, no secret recipe.
Write a post reminding people to order [holiday] cakes by [date]. Friendly, under 60 words, link [link].
Write a cake of the week post for [cake]: what is in it, who it is for, price [price].
Remind [name] the [amount] deposit for their [date] cake is due by [day], with my pay link [link].
Sort these receipts into ingredients, boxes, tools, rent, other: [paste]. Total each one.
My [cake] uses [ingredients and prices] and [hours] hours at [rate]. Show my cost.
Write my order policy in plain words: deposit [amount], changes until [days] days out, cancels [rules].
